episodes.207363: In the afternoon of the 16th, a cluster of supercell thunderstorms formed in eastern Kit Carson county and progressed to the northeast. Hail up to 1.75 inches was reported south of Idalia.
episodes.207364: In the afternoon of the 16th, a cluster of supercell thunderstorms formed in eastern Colorado and progressed to the northeast. Hail up to 1 inch was reported in St. Francis.
episodes.207382: Waterspouts developed near the coast of Galveston.
episodes.207610: A line of thunderstorms developed from far northeastern Colorado to around Valentine during the late afternoon hours of October 16th. As this activity moved east, gusty winds and mainly small hail fell from southwestern Nebraska into portions of central Nebraska. Hail up to nickel size was reported in far southeastern Perkins County.
